description: Two coordinated Minecraft interfaces. Light: the Overworld — grass, oak, cobblestone and stone bricks, bright bevels. Dark: the Deep — deepslate, obsidian, nether brick, dark oak and amethyst, cold bevels. All art is the real vanilla texture palette fetched from davidmc.cn, rendered as 16px tiles and nine-slice GUI frames. Verified against NarraFork v0.9.8 (33fc291) and v0.9.12.
